name: marketing-committee-chair-recommendation
description: LFX Marketing OS Marketing Committee Chair Recommendation Agent — when no one volunteers to chair an LF project's marketing committee, pulls the roster and member tiers from LFX, checks each representative's seniority and function on LinkedIn via the user's Chrome browser, scans social listening, and ranks who to personally invite as chair and vice-chair. Outputs a shortlist document with reasons, committee coverage gaps, and a suggested approach.
